cards.title: Functions that take a list
cards.body: A parameter can be a whole list. Inside the function, use it like any other list.

cards.title: Two decimal places
cards.body: In an f-string, `{value:.2f}` shows a number with exactly two digits after the point.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print `2.33`, but prints `2.333333`. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: Two decimal places is `:.2f`, with a dot. Without the dot, `2` sets a width, not the number of decimals.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: 5 / 2 is 2.5, and :.2f always shows two decimals, so it prints 2.50.
